content_name: QA Can You Install Vinyl Plank Over Existing Tile

actions.caption:
Can you install vinyl plank over existing tile? Usually yes, and it saves you a full demo day.

The tile has to pass three checks first:
1. Grout lines. Deep or wide ones may need a skim coat, or they telegraph through the vinyl.
2. Loose tiles. Anything hollow-sounding gets fixed before a plank goes down.
3. Height. Will your doors and appliances still clear the added thickness?

Pass all three and going over tile is a clean, smart upgrade. We do it all the time.
